author: Adoreil Ayoubgoulan
title: Man reported missing after apparent abduction in Tracy, deputies say - NewsBreak
text:
By Adoreil Ayoubgoulan ,
3 hours ago
(FOX40.COM) — Authorities are investigating the apparent abduction of 57-year-old Avtar Singh, who was reported missing in the Tracy area on Tuesday night.
• Video above: How to report a missing person
According to the San Joaquin County Sheriff’s Office, patrol deputies responded about 8:52 p.m. to the 16000 block of West Grant Line Road following a report of a missing person.
The sheriff’s office said during the investigation, deputies reviewed surveillance footage that showed Singh with three unidentified individuals dressed in dark clothing near a white SUV at about 2:30 p.m.
SJCSO reported that Singh appeared to enter the vehicle against his will.
Singh is described as 5 feet 7 inches tall and weighing about 200 pounds. He was last seen wearing light-colored traditional Sikh clothing, the sheriff’s office stated.
Image provided by the San Joaquin County Sheriff’s Office of 57-year-old Avtar Singh Detectives said the case appears to be an isolated incident, and there is no known ongoing threat to the community. The investigation remains active.
Anyone with information is urged to contact the San Joaquin County Sheriff’s Office.
